about.title: Engineering discipline meets modern software
about.note: From industrial control systems in Finland to scalable web platforms.
about.journeyText: My work in software began at the intersection of industrial automation engineering and modern web architecture. Studying how distributed sensors, controllers, and services communicate shaped how I design software today. Over the past four years I have focused on mastering TypeScript, the MERN stack, Prisma, and C++ to build deterministic AI agents and responsive web applications.
about.whatIDoText: I architect full stack web applications and automated workflows where reliability matters as much as interface clarity. Whether designing a normalized PostgreSQL schema, streaming LLM decisions to a browser client, or refining component interactions, I focus on measurable speed and maintainability.
about.offTheGridText: Away from code, I follow European football closely as a dedicated Manchester City supporter and never miss major international tournaments. I also spend my time exploring new cities and cultures, balancing the structured logic of software engineering with travel and sport.
